plan.title: Opening cue
plan.action: Start with “Ella Fitzgerald” as the familiar cue, then branch toward “Christian.” keep the pace gentle and low-pressure.
plan.why: The session starts from the supplied favorite “Ella Fitzgerald” and uses Qloo-ranked “Christian” as adjacent cultural evidence.

plan.title: Story bridge
plan.action: Bridge from “Singin' in the Rain” into “Jazz” with a film scene, photo, lyric, or memory prompt. Keep it for a small group with room for individual responses.
plan.why: “Singin' in the Rain” is a supplied favorite; Qloo-ranked “Jazz” provides the adjacent cultural bridge instead of a generic nostalgia prompt.

plan.title: Shared choice
plan.action: Offer two or three simple choices connected to “Inventive” and let participants steer the next activity.
plan.why: “Inventive” extends the known tastes into a related domain while preserving participant choice.

plan.title: Closing ritual
plan.action: Close with a snack, sensory cue, or conversation card inspired by “swing,” then ask what should return next time.
plan.why: “swing” keeps the closing step grounded in selected Qloo evidence so the plan ends in the same cultural neighborhood it started in.
